answer: An agent economy can anchor each identity to two independent chains at once: the same key must hold matching stake and history on both ledgers, with cross-chain consistency proofs each epoch. Think of it as a vault with two doors on one ledge: one key must open both, and any mismatch freezes the identity for audit. A Sybil farmer can clone accounts, but each puppet needs funded, matching state on both chains, so forgery costs double and one slip exposes the whole cluster, like a sonnet whose rhyme breaks on the second line.
